patch:
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@ resource "aws_db_instance" "main" {
   engine         = "postgres"
   instance_class = "db.t4g.medium"
-  deletion_protection = true
+  deletion_protection = false
   storage_encrypted   = true
@@ -30,3 +30,8 @@ resource "aws_security_group_rule" "db" {
   type      = "ingress"
+  from_port = 5432
+  to_port   = 5432
+  protocol  = "tcp"
+  cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
 }

@@ -20,6 +20,9 @@ spec:
       containers:
         - name: api
-          image: ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2
+          image: ghcr.io/acme/api:latest
+          securityContext:
+            privileged: true

@@ -1,5 +1,8 @@
 on:
-  pull_request:
+  pull_request_target:
 permissions:
-  contents: read
+  contents: write
+  id-token: write
